title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20
lineage: MC> R> C> DAT> HD> SHN> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent 1973 Santa Barbara show captured in a crystal‑clear audience recording; the Truckin > Other One > Eyes sequence shines and Jerry’s vocals are especially sweet.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this May 20, 1973 performance, calling the Truckin > Other One > Eyes jam one of the best of the year and praising Jerry Garcia’s unusually sweet vocal delivery. The audience tape is described as crystal‑clear and even outshines available soundboard versions, with the drums (Bill Kreutzmann) sounding particularly strong on the board but overall mix favoring the crowd source.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average >4.5), enthusiastic comments about both musical performance and audio quality, and multiple reviewers highlighting the same standout sequence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience recording praised as crystal‑clear; mix between vocals, Phil and Jerry noted as better than soundboard. Soundboard mentioned as decent with Bill's drums sounding clearer there, but overall audience source preferred.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam flow compared favorably to the 5/13 and 5/26 shows; strong, cohesive sequence that keeps energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Reviewer notes never hearing Jerry sing so sweet; vocals stand out in this performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming sounds better on the soundboard, though overall mix favors the audience recording.
